title: EARS_LOOK_ON on P60
behaviors: P41's sound-cued look, ported unchanged onto the P60 champion: with obs.alive <= 12, t >= 10, no target (no enemy and no farm mark), not hit in the last 2 s, no laser charge in progress, no drop run/hold and no drop near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M: aim the torso (yaw only, pitch 0) at the bearing of the newest mech-made sound heard in the last 2 s when that bearing is more than 30 deg off the champion's aim
hypothesis: P41 (sound-cued look, 3.84 vs P48 3.75) and P60 (back-away far cover, 3.88 vs P41 3.84, built on P48) change different decisions: P41 the torso aim with no target and no recent hit, P60 the legs in the hurt back-away retreat within 2 s of a hit. Their gains should add: P41's look rebuilt on P60 scores above 3.88 (F18 hypothesis).
mechanism: Same code as P41 c21d23b (brain.ts + params.ts: EARS_LOOK_ON, EARS_ALIVE 12, EARS_AGE_S 2, EARS_MIN_DEG 30; remember newest mech sound from obs.sounds; one extra aim source in the no-target branch after the lastHit line). No knob changes. Expected interaction with BACKAWAY_FAR_COVER_ON: none by construction (P60 fires only within 2 s of a hit, when P41's look is off; P60 changes legs only, P41 torso only).
activation: Step A on P60 afb6f26 (trees on, log-only): fired and changed the torso aim in 30/192 games (2000+3000; 48 episodes, 873 decisions) and 23/192 (4000+5000; 39 episodes, 699 decisions). Per base 2000 16, 3000 14, 4000 10, 5000 13. 0 in t < 10 s. Passive 384/384 (seed 3010 rerun alone after a 25 ms load tick hit the canPlan budget; the rerun matched). P41 on P48 was 29/192 and 25/192.
positives: Base 6000: paired +0.021 +/- 0.049 (3 better, 2 worse), kills 365->366. Gates clean on both bases: eqdrive identical, deaths <40 s 24=24 and 16=16, drop-ring arrivals 3=3 and 1=1, no new 20 s pin, check.py max 3.2 ms flag on and off. Look never fires with t < 10 s.
negatives: Base 0: paired -0.052 +/- 0.043 (0 better, 2 worse; kills 298->293). Seed 24: 5 look ticks at t 42 s, game diverges at 45 s, place 4->8, death 77.5->59.6 s, kills 12->8. Seed 6: place 8->9. Base 6000 seed 6034: the look is active (19 ticks at t 90.1-92.4) at the start of the champion's own 20 s pin at t 90-110 (same pin in P60, not new), place 10->12. Seed 6084 place 5->7, death 184.9->129.5 s.
outcome: pending (site score decides; local gates PASS)
disproof: Fails if the paired mean vs P60 is lower on BOTH practice bases (0 and 6000), or the site score is at or below 3.88.
source: Coordinator order 2:40 AM ET Sun Nov 22: re-test P41 EARS_LOOK as ONE change on the P60 champion (findings F18 hypothesis).
